The '''Count of Anavaisk''' is a noble title in the [[Duchy of Ledostrov]].

== Founding Role ==

Ledostrov's founding source says twenty-six nobles crowned the Count of Anavaisk as duke in 840. The title therefore anchors the duchy's earliest political legitimacy.

== Later Succession Note ==

The old source later names a young Countess of Anavaisk as [[Reznikoff of Ledostrov|Reznikoff]]'s granddaughter and possible heir. Because that passage is framed around 2003 concerns, this draft preserves it as a later succession issue rather than a settled 1994 fact.
